messages:
mel: Opening 75m change window to test a coordinated publish for Python + TS SDKs. Plan: push `canary-3690012345` dist-tags, kick off smoke + integration, route 10% internal. @jon you on publish, @maria_s prepare a short note mentioning pending deprecation.

jon: Builds ready. Will run `npm publish --tag canary-3690012345` and `twine upload -r testpypi dist/*`. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish job queued -> npm internal + pypi-staging. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/3690012345/build (checks running)

frank: Quick check 1: we added artifact signing in the new build; make sure consumers accept the signature header. Noted in the changelog draft.

maria_s: Draft note: "Internal canary only. Heads-up: signature header added for artifact verification; legacy sync client may need update. No GA changes planned." Draft: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/signature-canary-3690012345

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish succeeded for npm + pypi-staging. Dist-tag `canary-3690012345` created. Checksums: a7c9f2... :rocket:

mel: Routing 10% internal cohort now (flag: `sdk_canary_rollout` -> 10%). Dash: https://obs.redwood.example/d/sdk-canary-3690012345

tia: Monitoring set: p50/p99 latency, error-rate, token cost, and artifact-verify failures. Abort if verify failures >0.2% or error-rate >1%.

ops: Seeing small spike in artifact verification failures (0.6%) for the canary in eu-central-1. Looks like older clients failing signature check.

frank: Hmm. The signing key rotated on this build pipeline; older sync clients don't fetch the new key. That explains verify failures.

mel: Pause cohort routing. Jon, can you remove the dist-tag and unpublish staging wheel while we decide? Also prep a pin PR to pin internal infra to previous stable.

jon: Running rollback: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary-3690012345` and removing staging wheel where allowed. Also opening pin PR to pin internal configs to 1.3.4-stable: https://github.com/redwood/internal-configs/pull/678

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback executed. Dist-tag removed; traffic reverted to stable. Rollback logs: https://ci.redwood.example/3690012345/rollback :white_check_mark:

maria_s: Updating release notes: "Canary paused: artifact signature rotation caused verification failures for older clients. Stable unchanged. We'll coordinate a staged key-roll or migration docs." Adding migration steps and a deprecation notice for legacy sync client in a separate section.

mel: Quick action items: 1) roll back signing change on canary pipeline, 2) add backward-compatible key discovery to new client, 3) prepare staged key-roll doc and ops advisory, 4) re-run canary after fixes Wed 11:00 UTC. Assigning owners in ticket.

frank: I'll revert the signing step and add the key-discovery header. Also adding e2e test that validates older client behavior.

jon: Pin PR merged to internal-configs for ops emergency (pins 1.3.4-stable) so we can opt-out quickly if needed.

mel: Thanks all. We'll keep the public changelog unchanged; internal ops advisory will be distributed. Closing this window. :white_check_mark:
